title: Meet Daisha Auda, 15, first Torres Strait Islander to reach The Voice Australia grand final
summary_full: Daisha Auda, an inspiring self-taught singer from Logan, Queensland, has carved her name in history on The Voice Australia. She is the first Torres Strait Islander artist to reach the grand final, defying the odds by overcoming elimination in the knockout rounds, where she was saved by another judge. Auda's achievement resonates deeply with First Nations communities, sparking hope in aspiring young artists lacking formal training.
